q: 他今天来___很早。
zh: 他今天来得很早。
py: tā jīn tiān lái de hěn zǎo
en: He came very early today.
why: A comment on how early he came goes after the verb, linked by 得. 地 belongs before a verb, and 了 cannot sit between 来 and the comment.

q: 我昨天睡___很晚。
zh: 我昨天睡得很晚。
py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì de hěn wǎn
en: I went to bed very late yesterday.
why: How late he slept is a comment on the verb, so 睡 + 得 + 很晚. 地 would put the manner before the verb, and 昨天 already shows past time.

q: 这次会议开___太长了，大家都累了。
zh: 这次会议开得太长了，大家都累了。
py: zhè cì huì yì kāi de tài cháng le dà jiā dōu lèi le
en: The meeting ran too long, and everyone was tired.
why: Verb + 得 + 太 + adjective evaluates how the meeting went. 开了太长 is not Chinese; 了 cannot replace the link 得.

q: 医生说___很慢，我听懂了。
zh: 医生说得很慢，我听懂了。
py: yī shēng shuō de hěn màn wǒ tīng dǒng le
en: The doctor spoke very slowly, and I understood.
why: 说 + 得 + 很慢 describes the manner of speaking after the verb. 说了很慢 is ungrammatical, and 地 would have to come before 说.

q: 你昨天走___太早了，没看到经理。
zh: 你昨天走得太早了，没看到经理。
py: nǐ zuó tiān zǒu de tài zǎo le méi kàn dào jīng lǐ
en: You left too early yesterday and missed the manager.
why: Judging timing takes 走得太早了: 得 right after the verb, with the 了 at the end belonging to 太. 走了太早 is not possible.

q: 文件传___特别慢，我等了十分钟。
zh: 文件传得特别慢，我等了十分钟。
py: wén jiàn chuán de tè bié màn wǒ děng le shí fēn zhōng
en: The file transferred really slowly; I waited ten minutes.
why: The speed of the transfer is a comment after the verb: 传得特别慢. 传了特别慢 does not exist, and 地 goes before verbs.

q: 她从楼梯上摔下来，摔___很重，膝盖肿了。
zh: 她从楼梯上摔下来，摔得很重，膝盖肿了。
py: tā cóng lóu tī shàng shuāi xià lái shuāi de hěn zhòng xī gài zhǒng le
en: She fell down the stairs, and fell hard; her knee swelled up.
why: How hard she fell is a comment on 摔, so 摔得很重. 了 cannot be followed by 很重 in this meaning.

q: 他游泳___得很快。
zh: 他游泳游得很快。
py: tā yóu yǒng yóu de hěn kuài
en: He swims fast.
why: With the verb-object word 游泳, repeat the verb 游 before 得: 游泳游得很快. 泳得 would put 得 after a noun.

q: 我弟弟写字写___很难看。
zh: 我弟弟写字写得很难看。
py: wǒ dì di xiě zì xiě de hěn nán kàn
en: My little brother's handwriting is really ugly.
why: 写字 has an object, so 写 is repeated and 得 follows the second 写. 地 would go before the verb, and 了 cannot link a comment.

q: 李医生看病___得很仔细。
zh: 李医生看病看得很仔细。
py: lǐ yī shēng kàn bìng kàn de hěn zǎi xì
en: Doctor Li examines patients very carefully.
why: The verb in 看病 must be repeated before 得: 看病看得很仔细. The other verbs do not repeat the verb of the object phrase.

q: 小王打字打___特别快，一分钟能打一百个字。
zh: 小王打字打得特别快，一分钟能打一百个字。
py: xiǎo wáng dǎ zì dǎ de tè bié kuài yī fēn zhōng néng dǎ yī bǎi gè zì
en: Xiao Wang types really fast; he can type a hundred characters a minute.
why: After 打字, repeat 打 and add 得 for the comment 特别快. 得 cannot attach to the object 字.

q: 他睡觉睡___很香，叫了好几次都没醒。
zh: 他睡觉睡得很香，叫了好几次都没醒。
py: tā shuì jiào shuì de hěn xiāng jiào le hǎo jǐ cì dōu méi xǐng
en: He was sleeping soundly; I called him several times and he did not wake.
why: 睡觉 is verb + object, so the verb repeats and 得 links the comment 很香. 过 and 了 mark experience or completion, not a comment.

q: 她昨天加班加___太晚，今天一直在打哈欠。
zh: 她昨天加班加得太晚，今天一直在打哈欠。
py: tā zuó tiān jiā bān jiā de tài wǎn jīn tiān yī zhí zài dǎ hā qian
en: She worked overtime until very late yesterday and has been yawning all day.
why: 加班 has the object 班, so the verb repeats: 加班加得太晚. The 昨天 is enough to show it is past, so 了 is not squeezed between 加 and 得.

q: 他开车开___太快，我有点害怕。
zh: 他开车开得太快，我有点害怕。
py: tā kāi chē kāi de tài kuài wǒ yǒu diǎn hài pà
en: He drives too fast; I'm a bit scared.
why: After 开车 the verb is repeated: 开车开得太快. 开了太快 is not a possible comment on how he drives.

q: 她做饭___得很快，二十分钟就做好了三个菜。
zh: 她做饭做得很快，二十分钟就做好了三个菜。
py: tā zuò fàn zuò de hěn kuài èr shí fēn zhōng jiù zuò hǎo le sān gè cài
en: She cooks fast; she had three dishes ready in twenty minutes.
why: The repeated verb must be the same as the one in 做饭, and the clause that follows (做好了三个菜) confirms she is the cook. Other verbs would change the meaning.

q: 我爸爸打太极拳打___很标准，医生也夸他。
zh: 我爸爸打太极拳打得很标准，医生也夸他。
py: wǒ bà ba dǎ tài jí quán dǎ de hěn biāo zhǔn yī shēng yě kuā tā
en: My father does tai chi in a very proper way, and even the doctor praised him.
why: 打太极拳 has an object, so the verb 打 repeats and takes 得 before the comment 很标准. The comment cannot follow the object directly.

q: 他吃饭吃___很慢。
zh: 他吃饭吃得很慢。
py: tā chī fàn chī de hěn màn
en: He eats slowly.
why: The object 饭 forces a repeated verb: 吃饭吃得很慢. 地 would go before 吃, and 了 cannot link a comment.

q: 这份报告他写___非常认真。
zh: 这份报告他写得非常认真。
py: zhè fèn bào gào tā xiě de fēi cháng rèn zhēn
en: He wrote this report very carefully.
why: With the object fronted (这份报告), 得 follows the verb directly and nothing comes after the adjective. 地 belongs before the verb.

q: 英语他说___不错。
zh: 英语他说得不错。
py: yīng yǔ tā shuō de bù cuò
en: He speaks English quite well.
why: The topic 英语 is moved to the front, leaving 说 next to 得. 说地 and 说过 do not give an evaluation of how well he speaks.

q: 今天的饭你做___真好吃。
zh: 今天的饭你做得真好吃。
py: jīn tiān de fàn nǐ zuò de zhēn hǎo chī
en: You cooked today's meal really deliciously.
why: The object 今天的饭 is fronted, so 做得真好吃 works without repeating the verb. 做了真好吃 is not a possible comment.

q: 问题你回答___很清楚，我都听懂了。
zh: 问题你回答得很清楚，我都听懂了。
py: wèn tí nǐ huí dá de hěn qīng chu wǒ dōu tīng dǒng le
en: You answered the question clearly; I understood it all.
why: With 问题 fronted, 回答 + 得 + 很清楚 judges how he answered. 回答了很清楚 is not a comment on manner.

q: 他的汉字写___很漂亮。
zh: 他的汉字写得很漂亮。
py: tā de hàn zì xiě de hěn piào liang
en: He writes Chinese characters beautifully.
why: 得 must sit right after 写, with the object 他的汉字 in front. 地 goes before verbs, and 过 means past experience.

q: 昨天的会议记录小王整理___很详细，经理夸了他。
zh: 昨天的会议记录小王整理得很详细，经理夸了他。
py: zuó tiān de huì yì jì lù xiǎo wáng zhěng lǐ de hěn xiáng xì jīng lǐ kuā le tā
en: Xiao Wang put yesterday's meeting minutes in order in great detail, and the manager praised him.
why: The long object is fronted, so the verb 整理 takes 得 directly. 整理了很详细 would not describe how he did it.

q: 我昨天睡得___好，所以今天很累。
zh: 我昨天睡得不好，所以今天很累。
py: wǒ zuó tiān shuì de bù hǎo suǒ yǐ jīn tiān hěn lèi
en: I didn't sleep well last night, so I'm tired today.
why: Negate the comment with 不 after 得, even for past time. 没 cannot follow 得, and 很好 would not explain why he is tired.

q: 他今天说话说得___太清楚，我听不懂。
zh: 他今天说话说得不太清楚，我听不懂。
py: tā jīn tiān shuō huà shuō de bù tài qīng chu wǒ tīng bù dǒng
en: He wasn't speaking very clearly today, and I couldn't understand.
why: 不太 softens the negation and sits after 得. 没太 does not occur there, and 很太 is not possible.

q: 我最近胃不舒服，吃得___多，只能喝粥。
zh: 我最近胃不舒服，吃得不多，只能喝粥。
py: wǒ zuì jìn wèi bù shū fu chī de bù duō zhǐ néng hē zhōu
en: My stomach is upset lately; I don't eat much, only congee.
why: 吃得不多: the negative goes on the adjective after 得. 吃得很多 contradicts 只能喝粥, and 没 is not used after 得.

q: 她开车开得___太快，我坐她的车很放心。
zh: 她开车开得不太快，我坐她的车很放心。
py: tā kāi chē kāi de bù tài kuài wǒ zuò tā de chē hěn fàng xīn
en: She doesn't drive too fast; I feel safe in her car.
why: 不太快 puts the negative after 得. 很太快 is ungrammatical and 没 is never used here.

q: 他昨天写得___多，只写了一页。
zh: 他昨天写得不多，只写了一页。
py: tā zuó tiān xiě de bù duō zhǐ xiě le yī yè
en: He didn't write much yesterday, just one page.
why: 写得不多 is the negated comment. 太多 or 很多 would contradict 只写了一页, and 没多 cannot follow 得.

q: 这次培训大家学得___怎么好，经理不太满意。
zh: 这次培训大家学得不怎么好，经理不太满意。
py: zhè cì péi xùn dà jiā xué de bù zěn me hǎo jīng lǐ bù tài mǎn yì
en: Everyone did not learn very well in this training, and the manager isn't very satisfied.
why: 不怎么 weakens the adjective and follows 得. 很怎么好 is not possible, and 没 does not go after 得.

q: 孩子发烧了，昨天晚上睡得___安稳。
zh: 孩子发烧了，昨天晚上睡得不安稳。
py: hái zi fā shāo le zuó tiān wǎn shang shuì de bù ān wěn
en: The child had a fever and didn't sleep soundly last night.
why: The negative of the comment is 睡得不安稳, past time or not. 没安稳 is not used, and 很 would say the opposite of the English.

q: 经理今天讲得___快，所以我都记下来了。
zh: 经理今天讲得不快，所以我都记下来了。
py: jīng lǐ jīn tiān jiǎng de bù kuài suǒ yǐ wǒ dōu jì xià lái le
en: The manager didn't speak fast today, so I wrote everything down.
why: 讲得不快 negates the comment after 得. 太快 would make it impossible to write everything down, and 没快 is not Chinese.

q: 你昨晚睡得___？
zh: 你昨晚睡得怎么样？
py: nǐ zuó wǎn shuì de zěn me yàng
en: How did you sleep last night?
why: The question word 怎么样 stands after 得 and needs no 吗. Adding 吗 to 怎么样 or to an A-not-A question is a mistake.

q: 你觉得小李的英语说得好___好？
zh: 你觉得小李的英语说得好不好？
py: nǐ jué de xiǎo lǐ de yīng yǔ shuō de hǎo bù hǎo
en: Do you think Xiao Li speaks English well?
why: The A-not-A question is built on the adjective after 得: 好不好. 没 is not used here, 吗 is for yes-no questions, and 很 does not go inside A-not-A.

q: 你昨天睡得好___？
zh: 你昨天睡得好吗？
py: nǐ zuó tiān shuì de hǎo ma
en: Did you sleep well yesterday?
why: A plain yes-no question adds 吗 to the full statement 睡得好. 怎么样 or A-not-A would repeat the question.

q: 老师，这个字我写得___？
zh: 老师，这个字我写得好不好？
py: lǎo shī zhè gè zì wǒ xiě de hǎo bù hǎo
en: Teacher, did I write this character well?
why: A-not-A uses the bare adjective: 好不好. 很 cannot go inside it, and 吗 cannot be added to an A-not-A or 怎么样 question.

q: 你这次出差出得___？事情都办完了吗？
zh: 你这次出差出得怎么样？事情都办完了吗？
py: nǐ zhè cì chū chāi chū de zěn me yàng shì qing dōu bàn wán le ma
en: How did your business trip go? Did you finish everything?
why: 出差出得怎么样 asks how it went. 怎么样 is already a question word, so 吗 and 很 are wrong.

q: 他昨天加班加得很晚___？
zh: 他昨天加班加得很晚吗？
py: tā zuó tiān jiā bān jiā de hěn wǎn ma
en: Did he work overtime until very late yesterday?
why: The statement 加班加得很晚 becomes a yes-no question with 吗. The other endings need a bare adjective and no 很 before them.

q: 这位病人今天吃得多___多？
zh: 这位病人今天吃得多不多？
py: zhè wèi bìng rén jīn tiān chī de duō bù duō
en: Did this patient eat a lot today?
why: A-not-A on the adjective: 多不多. 没 is not used in this pattern, 吗 would make a different question, and 很 cannot sit inside it.

q: 今天办公室里热___很，我想开空调。
zh: 今天办公室里热得很，我想开空调。
py: jīn tiān bàn gōng shì lǐ rè de hěn wǒ xiǎng kāi kōng tiáo
en: It's really hot in the office today; I want to turn on the air conditioning.
why: Adjective + 得很 means very. 得 is required, and 地 belongs before verbs.

q: 我今天累___要命，想早点回家。
zh: 我今天累得要命，想早点回家。
py: wǒ jīn tiān lèi de yào mìng xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā
en: I'm dead tired today and want to go home early.
why: 累得要命 needs 得 between the adjective and 要命. 累要命 is the classic mistake.

q: 他听到自己升职了，高兴___不得了。
zh: 他听到自己升职了，高兴得不得了。
py: tā tīng dào zì jǐ shēng zhí le gāo xìng de bù dé liǎo
en: He was overjoyed to hear he'd been promoted.
why: 高兴得不得了 is a fixed intensifier and needs 得. 地 would turn 高兴 into a manner word before a verb.

q: 这几天我牙疼___要命，什么都吃不了。
zh: 这几天我牙疼得要命，什么都吃不了。
py: zhè jǐ tiān wǒ yá téng de yào mìng shén me dōu chī bù liǎo
en: My tooth has been killing me these days; I can't eat anything.
why: 疼得要命 is the intensifier for a bad feeling, and 得 cannot be dropped. 地 does not fit after a verb or adjective.

q: 这件事让他担心___要命。
zh: 这件事让他担心得要命。
py: zhè jiàn shì ràng tā dān xīn de yào mìng
en: This matter worries him to death.
why: 担心得要命: 得 links the feeling verb to 要命, which suits an unpleasant feeling. 担心地要命 is not possible.

q: 这个办法好___了，我们就用它吧。
zh: 这个办法好极了，我们就用它吧。
py: zhè gè bàn fǎ hǎo jí le wǒ men jiù yòng tā ba
en: This idea is excellent; let's use it.
why: 好极了 attaches 极了 directly with no 得. 得极 is a wrong blend, 要命 suits unpleasant things only, and 很了 is not Chinese.

q: 忙了一天，我累___了。
zh: 忙了一天，我累死了。
py: máng le yī tiān wǒ lèi sǐ le
en: After a whole day of work I'm exhausted.
why: 累死了 puts 死了 directly after the adjective, with no 得. Adding 得 or 很 breaks the fixed pattern.

q: 老板认真___听大家的意见。
zh: 老板认真地听大家的意见。
py: lǎo bǎn rèn zhēn de tīng dà jiā de yì jiàn
en: The boss listens carefully to everyone's opinions.
why: 认真 before the verb 听 describes the manner, so it takes 地. 得 only follows a verb and introduces a comment.

q: 她笑___很开心。
zh: 她笑得很开心。
py: tā xiào de hěn kāi xīn
en: She laughed very happily.
why: 很开心 comes after the verb as a comment on the laughing, so 笑得很开心. 地 would need the adjective in front of 笑.

q: 护士轻轻___把药放在桌子上。
zh: 护士轻轻地把药放在桌子上。
py: hù shi qīng qīng de bǎ yào fàng zài zhuō zi shàng
en: The nurse gently put the medicine on the table.
why: 轻轻 comes before the verb phrase, so it is joined by 地. 得 would have to follow a verb.

q: 医生耐心___给病人解释药怎么吃。
zh: 医生耐心地给病人解释药怎么吃。
py: yī shēng nài xīn de gěi bìng rén jiě shì yào zěn me chī
en: The doctor patiently explains to the patient how to take the medicine.
why: 耐心 describes the manner and sits before 给病人解释, so 地 is needed. 得 cannot follow it because no verb precedes.

q: 大家都说他讲___很清楚。
zh: 大家都说他讲得很清楚。
py: dà jiā dōu shuō tā jiǎng de hěn qīng chu
en: Everyone says he explained it very clearly.
why: 很清楚 judges how he explained, so it follows the verb with 得. 地 would put the manner before 讲.

q: 他慢慢___站起来，说头还有点晕。
zh: 他慢慢地站起来，说头还有点晕。
py: tā màn màn de zhàn qǐ lái shuō tóu hái yǒu diǎn yūn
en: He slowly stood up and said his head was still a bit dizzy.
why: 慢慢 before the verb 站起来 takes 地. 得 is only used after a verb.

q: 他___高，跑得也很快。
zh: 他很高，跑得也很快。
py: tā hěn gāo pǎo de yě hěn kuài
en: He is tall, and he also runs fast.
why: 他很高 describes the person, so 很 + adjective. The second half, 跑得也很快, describes the action, which needs 得.

q: 王医生的字写___很难看，但是人很好。
zh: 王医生的字写得很难看，但是人很好。
py: wáng yī shēng de zì xiě de hěn nán kàn dàn shì rén hěn hǎo
en: Doctor Wang's handwriting is ugly, but he is a nice person.
why: The comment is on how the writing is done, so 写得很难看. 写很难看 lacks the link 得, and 地 goes before verbs.

q: 小李个子不高，但是篮球打___很好。
zh: 小李个子不高，但是篮球打得很好。
py: xiǎo lǐ gè zi bù gāo dàn shì lán qiú dǎ de hěn hǎo
en: Xiao Li is not tall, but he plays basketball well.
why: How well he plays is a comment on 打, so 打得很好. 打很好 skips the link and 地 does not belong after a verb.

q: 爸爸的血压不太高，他走路走___很稳。
zh: 爸爸的血压不太高，他走路走得很稳。
py: bà ba de xuè yā bù tài gāo tā zǒu lù zǒu de hěn wěn
en: Dad's blood pressure is not too high, and he walks steadily.
why: 走路走得很稳 comments on how he walks, so 得 follows the repeated verb. 走路走很稳 has no link.

zh: 经理来得很早。
py: jīng lǐ lái de hěn zǎo
en: The manager came very early.
why: The comment 很早 follows 来 with 得 between them. 很早 cannot come before the verb to express how early he came, and 得 must touch 来.

zh: 她昨晚睡得不好。
py: tā zuó wǎn shuì de bù hǎo
en: She didn't sleep well last night.
why: The negative 不 belongs to the comment, after 得. 不 before 睡 would negate the sleeping itself.

zh: 她唱歌唱得非常好。
py: tā chàng gē chàng de fēi cháng hǎo
en: She sings extremely well.
why: 唱歌 has an object, so the verb 唱 repeats and takes 得. 得 cannot follow 歌.

zh: 这份报告他写得很认真。
py: zhè fèn bào gào tā xiě de hěn rèn zhēn
en: He wrote this report very carefully.
why: The object goes in front of the verb, either before or after the subject. 得 follows 写 directly and nothing comes after 很认真.

zh: 你昨天考得怎么样？
py: nǐ zuó tiān kǎo de zěn me yàng
en: How did you do on the exam yesterday?
why: 怎么样 sits after 得 where the comment would be. The question word needs no 吗.
